value.title: Prep canonical tables: sealed ports, pure folds, one incremental engine

value.principles: Hexagonal, functional core / imperative shell, constructor injection. core::prep owns every DTO and port; it has no I/O, Parquet, SQLite or engine dependency. Adapter crates implement PrepFold: pure, deterministic interpretation of supplied native input (JSONL records or a whole snapshot) into typed rows plus SessionFacts with a versioned checkpoint; no filesystem, clock or environment. Loaders implement PrepLoader: read-only discovery with skip accounting, stat, bounded reads to the last complete LF, prefix anchors, one-record reads at a native address. The SDK owns all prep semantics (root binding, change detection, generations, live tails, checkpoint compatibility, parallelism) and exposes fold_source, the single-source fold that prep, Plan 029 session status and external consumers share. output-prep implements PrepStore and is the only crate that knows Parquet/Arrow. The CLI turns argv into requests and renders reports; it holds no prep semantics. crates/app is the only composition root. No analytical engine is linked; research runs in external DuckDB over published Parquet.
value.composition_root: crates/app/src/main.rs dispatches; crates/app/src/prep.rs (new) holds the bindings table harness → {fold, loader}, resolves default roots from the adapter catalogue LocationHint (base + path) and HOME, merges explicit --root sets and opens ParquetPrepStore. Nothing else constructs concrete loaders, folds or stores.
contracts: core::prep (crates/core/src/prep.rs) is the single contract: PREP_TABLE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2, PREP_CHECKPOINT_FORMAT = 1. No Parquet, Arrow, SQLite, engine, filesystem or clock dependency in core or sdk (arch-check).

Sources: PrepSourceKind {Append, Snapshot}. PrepSourceSet {harness, label, root: PathBuf}; label "default" is the catalogue root, explicit roots default to "root-<first 8 hex of sha256(absolute root)>" unless named. Source key = "<harness>/<label>/<path relative to root>" and is the stable key in every table. PrepSourceStat {path, file (relative), kind, identity, size, mtime_ns} (snapshot loaders fold SQLite -wal/-shm sidecars into size/mtime). PrepSkipCounts {symlinks, hidden, unreadable_entries}. PrepDiscovery {sources, skipped}. NativeAddress {offset: Option<u64>, key: Option<String>}.

Rows (PrepRows {calls, turns, triggers, events, tool_uses}); every row starts (source, generation, native_offset, native_key). calls: sighting first|update, msg_id, request_id, ts, ts_ms, model, stop_reason (last non-null), input, cw_1h, cw_5m, cache_read, output, cache_write_basis (split|fallback_1h|fallback_5m|none), is_sidechain, gap_ms, turn_no, call_in_turn, records. turns: turn_no, started_ts, started_ts_ms, first_call_offset, origin (start|human|peer|task_notification|coordinator|auto_continuation|loop|compact|subagent_task|system|other), sender, pij_msg_id, opener_offset, opener_ts_ms, opener_chars, body_key. triggers: ts, ts_ms, kind, sender, pij_msg_id, chars, body_key, next_turn_no, content_head (only with include_content). events: ts, ts_ms, kind (compaction|recap|scheduled_fire|limit_notice|queue_op|model_switch|api_error|system_other), subkind, trigger, model (model_switch: requested model), pre_tokens, post_tokens (native compact_boundary postTokens only), duration_ms, last_context, gap_ms, resets_at (native phrase), resets_at_ms (parsed only when the source allows), turn_no, body_key. tool_uses: sighting use|result, tool_use_id, call_msg_id, name (native), family, input_hash, input_bytes, result_offset, result_bytes, outcome (ok|error|unknown), duration_ms (native only), turn_no. Unknown or unrecorded = null, never estimated.

SessionFacts (core; the SDK-level contract Plan 029 session-status and Flowspace3 reuse without a target dir): session_id, parent_session_id, is_sidechain, cwd, first_event_ts/_ms and last_event_ts/_ms (latest native event timestamp, never mtime), records, calls, turns, latest_context: Option<ContextSample {ts_ms, model, stop_reason, input, cache_read, cache_write, total}> (latest deduplicated main-chain call; sidechain calls excluded), compactions: Option<CompactionCounts {manual, auto, unknown_trigger}> (None only when the dialect has no native compaction marker), last_compaction: Option<{ts_ms, trigger, pre_tokens, post_tokens, first_context_after}> (first_context_after = context of the first new main-chain call after the boundary, None until one exists), last_model_switch: Option<{ts_ms, requested_model}>, seat_hint, skipped {malformed, untimed, bad_timestamp}. PrepSourceMeta {is_sub, agent_id, project} comes from PrepFold::describe(file), never from the store.

trait PrepLoader: kind() -> PrepSourceKind; discover(&self, root: &Path, accept: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Result<PrepDiscovery>; stat(&self, root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<PrepSourceStat>; read(&self, stat: &PrepSourceStat, from: Option<&ReadCursor>, limits: PrepReadLimits) -> Result<PrepBatch>; anchor(&self, stat: &PrepSourceStat, offset: u64) -> Result<String> (Append only; Snapshot returns Unsupported); record_at(&self, path: &Path, address: &NativeAddress, max_bytes: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>>. PrepBatch {input: PrepInput, next_cursor: Option<ReadCursor>, more, incomplete_tail, bytes_read}; PrepInput = Records(Vec<NativeRecord>) | Snapshot(NativeSnapshot). Append reads stop at the last complete LF. Loaders open native stores read-only and never lock, rename or write them.

trait PrepFold (pure, in adapter crates): harness() -> &'static str; policy() -> &'static str; kind() -> PrepSourceKind; pattern() -> &'static str (glob relative to the root); describe(&self, file: &str) -> PrepSourceMeta; open(&self, meta: &PrepSourceMeta, generation: u32, saved: Option<&PrepCheckpoint>) -> Result<Box<dyn PrepFoldSession>>; a saved checkpoint with another policy or format is refused (InvalidData), never reinterpreted. trait PrepFoldSession: fold(&mut self, input: &PrepInput, options: PrepOptions) -> Result<PrepRows>; checkpoint(&self) -> PrepCheckpoint {format, policy, fold: serde_json::Value}; facts(&self) -> SessionFacts. Equal (checkpoint, input, options) give equal output; folding a stream in any batch split, or resuming from a checkpoint, equals one uninterrupted fold.

trait PrepStore: state(&self) -> Result<Option<PrepState>> (read-only); load(&self) -> Result<PrepLoaded {state, orphans_removed}> (recovers a crashed run); commit(&self, rows: &PrepRows, state: &PrepState) -> Result<PrepCommit> (rows durable first, state published last by atomic rename); compact(&self) -> Result<PrepCompactReport>. An implementation excludes concurrent writers for its lifetime. PrepState {table_schema_version, checkpoint_format, runs, parts, sets: BTreeMap<set key, PrepSetState {harness, label, root, policy}>, sources: BTreeMap<source key, PrepSourceState {set, path, file, kind, identity, size, mtime_ns, offset, anchor, revision, generation, meta, checkpoint, facts, status}>}.

Outcomes: PrepSourceStatus = New | Unchanged | Appended | Replaced {reason: Rotated|Truncated|Rewritten|Revision|Policy|Schema|RootMoved} | Unreadable | Unsupported | Missing. PrepReport {target, table_schema_version, run, sets: Vec<PrepSetReport {harness, label, root, policy, supported, discovered, skipped: PrepSkipCounts, by_status}>, bytes_read, pending_tail_bytes, rows_written: PrepTableCounts {calls, turns, triggers, events, tool_uses}, commit, sources: Vec<PrepSourceOutcome> (every source whose status is not Unchanged)}.

PrepApi (core; the CLI's only prep dependency): prep(&PrepRequest) -> Result<PrepReport>; compact(&PrepCompactRequest {target}) -> Result<PrepCompactReport>; record(&PrepRecordRequest {target, source, address, include_content}) -> Result<PrepRecord>. PrepRequest {target, roots: Vec<PrepSourceSet>, options: PrepOptions {include_content}, limits: PrepReadLimits {read: ReadLimits, snapshot: SnapshotLimits}, threads, modified_since_ns}. record with include_content = false is refused (InvalidInput) before any native read.

SDK (crates/sdk/src/prep.rs): Preparer::new(bindings: Vec<PrepBinding {fold: Arc<dyn PrepFold>, loader: Arc<dyn PrepLoader>}>, store: S) implements PrepApi; a root whose harness has no binding is reported supported = false with its sources Unsupported. fold_source(loader: &dyn PrepLoader, fold: &dyn PrepFold, stat: &PrepSourceStat, resume: Option<&PrepResume>, options: PrepOptions, limits: PrepReadLimits, sink: &mut dyn FnMut(PrepRows)) -> Result<SourceFold {checkpoint, facts, cursor, anchor, revision, bytes_read, pending_tail_bytes}> is the single-source in-memory fold used by run_prep, Plan 029 and external consumers.

Table contract (output-prep only): TARGET/state.json; TARGET/tables/{calls,turns,triggers,events,tool_uses}/*.parquet append-only parts; TARGET/tables/{sources,sessions}.parquet current snapshots; Parquet key-value metadata unisphere.table_schema_version; TARGET/views.sql (DuckDB) defining calls_v (current generation, grouped by (source, generation, msg_id, request_id) with per-field max, stop_reason last non-null), turns_v, triggers_v, events_v, compactions_v (with first_context_after), tool_uses_v (use+result merged), sources_v, sessions_v. Column names avoid SQL reserved words. Compaction rewrites current-generation rows only and changes no view result.

CLI argv (frozen): unisphere prep --target DIR [--root HARNESS[:LABEL]=DIR]... [--harness H]... [--no-default-roots] [--include-content] [--max-record-bytes N] [--max-batch-bytes N] [--threads N] [--modified-since RFC3339] [--json|--human]; unisphere prep compact --target DIR; unisphere prep record --target DIR --source KEY (--offset N | --key K) --include-content. Phase 2 adds unisphere prep recipes [--json] and unisphere prep recipe NAME --target DIR (prints a self-contained DuckDB script; documented use: `unisphere prep recipe NAME --target DIR | duckdb`). Exit 0 ok, 3 when any source is Unreadable, 2 usage, 1 error; envelope {ok, command, v, data, next_action} like existing verbs.

Phase 2 adds folds and a snapshot loader against the same ports: a Snapshot source re-reads wholly on any stat change; equal NativeSnapshot.revision → Unchanged, otherwise a new generation. No phase-2 port change is planned; any required change is a PM contract delta sealed before phase-2 dispatch.

Planned phase-2 lanes (guide v2 decomposes and seals them): Oh My Pi and Pi prep folds [crates/adapter-omp/src/prep.rs, crates/adapter-pi/src/prep.rs]: OmpPrepFold and PiPrepFold: PrepFold (kind Append, pattern "*/*.jsonl"). v3 session trees: calls are assistant messages with usage (dedupe on native id); branch membership from parent ids carried in the checkpoint; compaction/branch-summary entries → compaction events (compactions Some); pij envelopes in user messages → peer origin; tool calls/results → tool_uses. lib.rs change limited to the module declaration and re-export. Fixtures are synthetic and content-free. | Codex prep fold [crates/adapter-codex/src/prep.rs]: CodexPrepFold: PrepFold (kind Append, pattern "????/??/??/rollout-*.jsonl"). Model from turn_context (the query mapping omits it); per-call usage from last-turn token_count, cumulative totals never double counted; cache write only where native; compacted records → compaction events; function/custom tool calls, outputs and shell exit outcomes → tool_uses; parent/fork thread ids → parent_session_id. Fixtures are synthetic and content-free. | Copilot CLI prep folds [crates/adapter-copilot-cli/src/prep.rs]: CopilotCliPrepFold (kind Append, pattern "*/events.jsonl") and CopilotCliLegacyPrepFold (kind Snapshot, JSON document, pattern "*.json"). Events: model selection/changes, message/API usage (input/output/cache read/write), compaction events, tool calls/results/outcomes. Legacy snapshot has no model or usage: explicit nulls and coverage, chat rows without timestamps stay untimed. Fixtures are synthetic and content-free. | VS Code Copilot prep fold [crates/adapter-vscode-copilot/src/prep.rs]: VsCodeCopilotPrepFold for JsonDocument ("*/chatSessions/*.json") and JsonJournal ("*/chatSessions/*.jsonl") snapshots. Journal reduced to its current document before folding; native prompt/completion token data mapped where present (the query mapping omits usage); tool name/family/status; everything else explicit null. Fixtures are synthetic and content-free. | Cursor prep folds [crates/adapter-cursor/src/prep.rs]: CursorTranscriptPrepFold (kind Append, pattern "*/agent-transcripts/**/*.jsonl") and CursorIdePrepFold (kind Snapshot, SqliteKeyValue cursorDiskKV). Transcript records carry no ids, timestamps, models or usage: rows keyed by native offset with explicit nulls. IDE composer/bubble records: modelConfig/modelInfo and tokenCount/usageData mapped where present (the query mapping omits them); tool call/result outcomes. Fixtures are synthetic and content-free. | Snapshot prep loader [crates/loader-snapshot/src/prep.rs]: SnapshotPrepLoader::new(format: SnapshotFormat) -> Self; impl PrepLoader (kind Snapshot). lib.rs change limited to the module declaration and re-export. | Research recipes [crates/cli/recipes]: run_prep_recipes(&PrepRecipesCommand, stdout, stderr) -> u8; run_prep_recipe(&PrepRecipeCommand, stdout, stderr) -> u8; ParsedCommand::{PrepRecipes, PrepRecipe}. No engine is linked and the CLI never shells out. Recipes may be validated locally with an installed DuckDB; the PM's vd-000c is the external-engine proof. | Phase-2 composition and full-corpus proof [crates/app/src/prep.rs, crates/testkit/src/bin/proof/prep.rs]: `unisphere prep` over every registered harness; unisphere-proof prep (all representations); assets/proof/{measure.py,recipes_check.py}. Catalogue descriptor edits in adapter lib.rs files happen only here, after the fold units delivered.

value.rationale: Phase 1 splits into four behaviours that run and prove independently against the sealed v2 contract and testkit fakes: the Claude fold (pure, fixture-driven), the incremental engine (SDK + JSONL loader, driven by RecordingFold and MemoryPrepStore), the Parquet store (driven by synthetic PrepRows/PrepState) and the CLI frontend (driven by a fake PrepApi). The coupling that could force them together — state semantics shared by engine and store — is removed by freezing PrepState and the load/commit/compact protocol in the baseline. Integration (composition root, catalogue, proof mode, real-corpus parity) stays with the PM. Coders never import sibling implementations in the same wave. Phase 2 cannot share this roster: builder composition imports every coder of a guide exactly once on one frozen baseline, and phase-2 lanes must start from the verified phase-1 composition. Phase 2 is therefore guide v2 (re-reviewed, re-sealed on the phase-1 composed SHA) with these planned lanes: Oh My Pi and Pi prep folds; Codex prep fold; Copilot CLI prep folds; VS Code Copilot prep fold; Cursor prep folds; Snapshot prep loader; Research recipes; Phase-2 composition and full-corpus proof. Each phase-2 fold lane also flips its own descriptor's cli_persisted_resume, so adapter lib.rs files have one writer.

value.path: prep argv → PrepRequest → Preparer::prep → per-source stat/anchor/cursor decision → fold_source → PrepStore::commit (rows, then state by rename); unchanged run returns before any body read or commit.
FileSessionLoader batches end at the last complete LF → pending_tail_bytes per outcome → next run resumes at the committed cursor.

External SDK consumer (Preparer + own PrepStore) and installed CLI over the same roots produce equal canonical rows; arch-check keeps Parquet/SQLite/engines out of core and sdk; catalogue reports cli_persisted_resume for covered harnesses.
ClaudePrepFold call rules on synthetic fixtures, then real-corpus calls_v vs copied extract.py field by field.
ClaudePrepFold typed events, turn origin, sidechain link and tool_uses rows on synthetic fixtures.
Every catalogued harness binding (fold + loader + default roots) emits the same PrepRows contract with explicit nulls and per-source coverage.
Discovery skip accounting and per-set status counts in PrepReport, extra roots via --root, rendered by the CLI.
ParquetPrepStore schema metadata, views.sql, generation semantics and prep compact with view results unchanged.
`unisphere prep recipe NAME --target DIR | duckdb` for every named recipe; clear error when DuckDB is absent; no engine linked.
calls/turns/tool_uses native_offset/native_key + sources.path → PrepApi::record → PrepLoader::record_at, content only with --include-content.
Metadata-only default across fold, store and CLI; content columns absent unless opted in; native stores opened read-only; fixtures synthetic.
Full-corpus cold / unchanged / append runs timed with peak RSS, bytes read and documented bounds (threads × batch bytes) vs the POC baseline.
Bundled prep and research-recipes topics with parsed examples; installed-CLI docs parity.

value.name: Prep contract v2 baseline
value.responsibility: Freeze core::prep v2 exactly as architecture.contracts states, with contract fixture tests; testkit prep fakes (MemoryPrepStore with injectable commit failure, MemoryLoader supporting append / partial tail / truncate / rotate / rewrite / snapshot sources, RecordingFold); arch-check allowlist edits for every new edge; all dependency and Cargo.lock changes any unit needs. Compile-level adaptation of the POC implementations to v2 so the workspace stays green; behaviour stays POC-equivalent and ownership of those files passes to the wave-1 units at seal.
value.interface: core::prep v2 (see architecture.contracts) and unisphere_testkit::prep::{MemoryPrepStore, MemoryLoader, RecordingFold}.
value.notes: Sealed with harness builder contracts --seal after an independent decomposition review. Wave-1 packets start from the sealed SHA; no wave-1 unit may change core::prep, testkit fakes, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock — a needed change is a PM contract delta.

value.name: Claude prep fold
value.responsibility: Harden ClaudePrepFold into product: reference-parser rules (per-source-generation dedupe on (message.id, requestId) with per-field max; repeats across batches or runs become update sightings; cache_creation 1h/5m split with the documented fallback main→1h, subagent→5m and cache_write_basis; <synthetic> assistant records are limit_notice events, never calls; per-call gap from the preceding new call; turn origin precedence and sender precedence exactly as extract.py); typed events (compaction trigger/pre/post/duration, recap, scheduled_fire → loop origin, limit_notice with resets_at_ms when the record timestamp and phrase allow, queue_op, model_switch from the native /model command record); stop_reason; tool_uses (native name, family, input hash/bytes, result offset/bytes, outcome, native duration); sidechain parent link; SessionFacts incl. latest_context, compactions, last_compaction.first_context_after, last_model_switch; content only under include_content; versioned checkpoint.
value.interface: ClaudePrepFold: PrepFold (harness "claude-code", policy "claude-code/prep-v3", kind Append, pattern "**/*.jsonl").
value.notes: Fixtures are synthetic and content-free (fabricated ids, short placeholder texts). Behavioural tests cover every rule above plus batch-split and checkpoint-resume equivalence. The POC's reference-parity knowledge (window boundary state, 0.1 s gap rounding at ties) is documented in the fold, not hidden; real-corpus parity is the PM's vd-000a.

value.name: Incremental engine and JSONL prep loader
value.responsibility: SDK owns prep semantics: bind roots to folds/loaders by harness; per-set policy/schema/root compatibility; per-source change detection (stat → anchor → cursor for Append; stat → revision for Snapshot) into New / Unchanged / Appended / Replaced{reason} / Unreadable / Unsupported / Missing; generations; failed sources keep their previous committed state; unchanged sources cost one stat and nothing is committed when nothing changed; live tails stop at the last complete LF and report pending bytes; bounded parallelism; fold_source as the single-source fold; record fetch through record_at with content opt-in enforced. FileSessionLoader implements PrepLoader: read-only discovery honouring accept, counting skipped symlinks and hidden entries, stat, anchors, batches, record_at at an offset that must begin a complete line.
value.interface: unisphere_sdk::prep::{Preparer, PrepBinding, fold_source, SourceFold, PrepResume}; FileSessionLoader: PrepLoader.
value.notes: Tests use RecordingFold + MemoryPrepStore for engine semantics (crash between rows and state, concurrent non-LF-aligned writer thread with random chunk sizes whose final canonical rows equal a fresh run, same-size same-mtime rewrite detected at next growth by anchor) and real temp files for the loader. Snapshot-kind paths are proven with MemoryLoader snapshot sources now so phase 2 adds only loaders and folds. loader-jsonl/src/lib.rs changes are limited to the PrepLoader impl block.

value.name: Parquet prep store
value.responsibility: ParquetPrepStore owns the physical table contract: open(target) takes an exclusive advisory lock for its lifetime; commit writes synced parts per table (incl. tool_uses) then sources/sessions snapshots then state.json by atomic rename with directory fsyncs; load removes parts unreferenced by the published state; compact rewrites current-generation rows (merging call and tool-use sightings) into new parts, publishes state, then deletes superseded parts; Parquet key-value schema-version metadata; views.sql with the canonical DuckDB views; source/session snapshots derive project/agent columns from PrepSourceMeta, not from Claude path knowledge.
value.interface: ParquetPrepStore::open(target: PathBuf) -> Result<Self, PipelineError>; impl PrepStore.
value.notes: Tests read Parquet back through parquet's Arrow reader + arrow-json and apply the canonical-view rules in Rust to prove compaction leaves every view result unchanged and that injected failures between parts and state leave the previous publication intact. No new workspace dependency without a PM contract delta.

value.name: CLI prep frontend and docs
value.responsibility: Parse the frozen prep argv into PrepCommand / PrepCompactCommand / PrepRecordCommand (explicit roots, harness filters, limits, content opt-in); render PrepReport, PrepCompactReport and PrepRecord as machine envelopes and a concise human summary (per-set coverage, statuses, skipped counts, pending tails); exit codes; no prep semantics in the CLI. Bundled `prep` docs topic: table contract, canonical views, incremental and generation semantics, coverage vocabulary, privacy defaults, SDK reuse (fold_source, own PrepStore) and one-line examples bound in a parsed example manifest; README quick start; docs/cli.md and docs/sdk.md prep sections.
value.interface: run_prep(&PrepCommand, roots: Vec<PrepSourceSet>, &dyn PrepApi, stdout, stderr) -> u8; run_prep_compact(..) -> u8; run_prep_record(..) -> u8; ParsedCommand::{Prep, PrepCompact, PrepRecord}.
value.notes: Default-root resolution stays in the composition root (it needs the catalogue and HOME); the CLI passes explicit roots and flags. query_frontend.rs changes are limited to the docs-topic count.

value.name: Phase-1 composition and Claude real-workload proof
value.responsibility: Import wave-1 deliveries; wire crates/app/src/prep.rs (bindings table, default roots from the catalogue LocationHint, explicit roots, ParquetPrepStore::open) and dispatch in main.rs; set cli_persisted_resume = true for claude-code; add the `prep` proof mode (external SDK consumer with its own in-memory PrepStore, built and installed CLI) and wire it into boot; compose --verify; real-corpus parity against copied extract.py, fleet measurement and live proof in gitignored scratch with numbers-only evidence; independent composition review.
value.interface: `unisphere prep` end to end; unisphere-proof prep; assets/proof/{parity.py,measure.py,live.py} writing only to .harness/temp/prep-real.
